mapper.select: SELECT * FROM checkin WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND goal_id = #{goalId} AND date = #{date} AND task_id IS NULL LIMIT 1

SELECT pt.id, COALESCE(p.goal_id, p.id) as goalId, pt.task_name as taskName, pt.task_type as taskType, pt.task_description as taskDescription, pt.task_duration as taskDuration, pt.completed, pt.task_date as taskDate, p.user_id as userId, c.status as checkinStatus, c.proof_image as proofImage, c.proof_content as proofContent FROM plan_task pt JOIN plan p ON pt.plan_id = p.id LEFT JOIN checkin c ON c.task_id = pt.id AND c.date = pt.task_date WHERE p.user_id = #{userId} AND p.status = 'active' AND pt.task_date = #{today} ORDER BY pt.sort_order
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO checkin (user_id, goal_id, task_id, content, image, checkin_time, date, status, partner_id, proof_image, proof_content) VALUES (#{userId}, #{goalId}, #{taskId}, #{content}, #{image}, NOW(), #{date}, #{status}, #{partnerId}, #{proofImage}, #{proofContent})
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ( SELECT date, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY date DESC) as rn FROM checkin WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND (goal_id = #{goalId} OR #{goalId} IS NULL) AND status = 'approved' AND date <= #{today} GROUP BY date ORDER BY date DESC ) t WHERE DATEDIFF(#{today}, date) = rn - 1
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT date) FROM checkin WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND (goal_id = #{goalId} OR #{goalId} IS NULL) AND status = 'approved'
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM plan_task WHERE task_date = #{today} AND completed = 1
mapper.update: UPDATE checkin SET status = #{status}, partner_id = #{partnerId}, review_comment = #{reviewComment}, review_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'pending'

UPDATE checkin SET content = #{content}, image = #{image}, proof_image = #{proofImage}, proof_content = #{proofContent}, status = #{status}, checkin_time = NOW(), partner_id = NULL, review_comment = NULL, review_time = NULL WHERE id = #{id} AND user_id = #{userId} AND status = 'rejected'
mapper.select: SELECT c.*, u.nickname as reviewerNickname, u.avatar as reviewerAvatar FROM checkin c LEFT JOIN user u ON c.partner_id = u.id WHERE c.goal_id = #{goalId} AND c.status = 'pending' ORDER BY c.checkin_time DESC

SELECT c.*, g.name as goalName, u.nickname as userNickname, u.avatar as userAvatar FROM checkin c JOIN goal g ON g.id = c.goal_id AND g.user_id = c.user_id AND g.status != 'deleted' JOIN user u ON u.id = c.user_id WHERE c.status = 'pending' AND c.user_id != #{userId} AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM partner p WHERE p.status = 'accepted' AND ((p.user_id = #{userId} AND p.partner_id = c.user_id) OR (p.partner_id = #{userId} AND p.user_id = c.user_id)) ) ORDER BY c.checkin_time DESC
SELECT MIN(date) FROM checkin WHERE user_id = #{userId}
